rationale_bullets: Only FBS tape in the room is Najm's 33.7/85 (3 st, 473 @ 50% as the #4 QB) -> MAC -10 = 24-equiv; the team PASS grade was p2 nationally.

Novosad (Oregon, ex-4-star, QB2 behind Nix/Gabriel/Moore) is pure pedigree - 4 passes in 3 years; Athlon 'potentially elite... the guy in the fall', PS QB #14 but PS's own lineup starts Kastantin - OPEN battle.
Kastantin is real D2 production (3,658 @ 57%, 37 TD + 710 rush over 3 yrs; 9 st, 1,974, 19-5 in '25) - no offset cell, unproven vs FBS.
34, L: pedigree ceiling on a production floor of nothing; nets even with Akron QB 34 (proven-MAC floor, lower ceiling) and far above FIU-15 (empty room, no pedigree).
